remarks: Bright & Airy Southwest facing corner apartment in the pulse of exciting and sophisticated downtown Stamford. Come fall in love with the pre-war detailing - sun filled rooms, you'll also enjoy high 9' ceilings, hardwood floors, fresh new paint. Most importantly - Location, location, location - walk to UCONN, Theaters, popular restaurants, shops, bars, pubs, train station and the Ferguson Library. Parking is available across the street in the Bedford St. garage (about 75.00 monthly), heat and hot water are included in the rent. Building entry & elevator soon to be beautifully renovated.
